prompt: how do large language models like ChatGPT work

plan.title: How ChatGPT Really Works: Guessing the Next Word
plan.description: Large language models like ChatGPT are trained on huge amounts of text to predict the next word. This short video explains how that simple trick produces fluent answers.

beats.narration: ChatGPT doesn't actually know anything. It's just playing one game: guess the next word. Over and over, super fast.

props.text: It just guesses the next word.

beats.narration: It learned by reading a giant pile of text, spotting patterns in how words follow each other, until its guesses got scary good.
So when you ask a question, it builds an answer one word at a time. Smart-sounding, but still just predicting.
